summary.zh-Hant: 埃及的地位：名義上屬鄂圖曼蘇丹宗主權，由赫迪夫治理，1882 年起由英國佔領並控制財政。1914-12-18 英國宣布鄂圖曼宗主權終止、埃及成為英國保護國。英國在這之前沒有主張埃及的主權，所以不列為主張方；本系統不裁判當時誰才算主權者。
summary.en: Status of Egypt: nominally under the suzerainty of the Ottoman Sultan, governed by the Khedive, and under British occupation and financial control since 1882. On 18 December 1914 Britain declared the suzerainty terminated and Egypt a British protectorate. Britain made no claim to sovereignty before that date and is not listed as a claimant.

position.zh-Hant: 赫迪夫政府實際治理埃及（在英國佔領之下）。出處：Shepherd 1911 pp. 174–175 圖例「Egypt tributary to the Ottoman Empire, and subject to the financial control of Great Britain」（B）。
position.en: The Khedivial government administered Egypt (under British occupation). Source: Shepherd 1911, pp. 174–175, legend "Egypt tributary to the Ottoman Empire, and subject to the financial control of Great Britain" (grade B).

position.zh-Hant: 對埃及有宗主權，到 1914-12-18 為止。出處：英國外交部 1914-12-18 電報稱「the suzerainty of Turkey over Egypt is terminated」（FRUS 1914 Supplement Doc. 274，A，第三方／佔領方的官方文件）；鄂圖曼自己的出處還沒取得。沒有另外畫範圍。
position.en: Held suzerainty over Egypt until 18 December 1914. Source: British Foreign Office telegram of that date, "the suzerainty of Turkey over Egypt is terminated" (FRUS 1914 Supplement, Doc. 274, grade A; a document of the occupying power). No Ottoman source obtained yet. No separate extent is drawn.
